|printed_game_text=<span lang="ja">1フォース消費して、未踏査の位置カードの、相手側に配備できる。自分の支配フェイズに、キャラクターと同じようにフォースを消費して移動できる。ターキンまたは能力値&lt;3のエイリアンと同じ場所についたら、そのうち1枚を選んで、ロストデッキへ送る。このカードもロストデッキへ。</span><ref name="photo" />
|printed_lore=<span lang="ja">軍用リモート。特定の個人や、条件を指定しての追跡をプログラムされている。熱光学センサーできわめて正確に対象を追跡する。宇宙船に潜り込ませることも可能。</span><ref name="photo" />
|translation='''Title:''' Tarkin Seeker.<ref name="photo" />

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on the opponent's side of an unexplored location card. During your control phase, it can move by using Force like a character. When it reaches the same location as Tarkin or an alien with ability less than 3, choose one of them and send it to the Lost Pile. This card also goes to the Lost Pile.<ref name="photo" />

'''Lore:''' A military remote. Programmed to pursue specified individuals or targets meeting specified conditions. Heat and optical sensors track targets with extreme accuracy. It can also be slipped aboard a starship.<ref name="photo" />

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says an unexplored location card; the English says an unoccupied site. The Japanese does not include the English word “immediately” when the target is lost. The English lore says “secondary targets” and “fatal accuracy”; the Japanese instead describes specified conditions and extreme accuracy.<ref name="photo" /><ref name="english-face">[[:File:Premiere-L-tarkinseeker-decipher-archive.gif|Tarkin Seeker original English printed face]].</ref>
